fixes.answer: Several factors are at play. The demands of modern careers are [[relentless]], leaving parents exhausted and [[time-poor]]. On top of that, digital devices have become a real distraction, with family members often absorbed in their own screens even when in the same room. This gradual erosion of shared time is genuinely [[detrimental]] to close relationships.

I anticipate that families will continue to become smaller and more diverse in form. We will likely see more single-parent households and [[blended families]] becoming [[commonplace]] and widely accepted. Technology may also allow [[far-flung]] relatives to stay connected more easily. Overall, I think the definition of family will grow more flexible and inclusive.
fixes.why: 'diverse' and 'flexible' are plain; marked 'blended families' and 'far-flung'
